# Hedwig

> Our vision pairs curated knowledge with a Jev score and a report on request. Start with a free local policy check.

## Pages

- [Hedwig | Check before your agent pays](https://usehedwig.xyz/): Our vision pairs curated knowledge with a Jev score and a report on request. Start with a free local policy check.
- [About | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/about): Hedwig brings an eval into your agent's payment flow. Its product vision combines curated knowledge, a Jev score and a report when you ask.
- [How it works | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works): Explore Hedwig's product vision: a Jev payment assessment and a report on request. Start with the local policy checker.
- [Proof | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof): Inspect Hedwig's recorded Solana devnet checks, including a request over its amount limit and a revoked role.
- [Product direction | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap): Hedwig's direction: payment assessments informed by curated knowledge, an explanation on request, and an open core with paid hosted assessments.
- [Team | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/team): Hi, I'm Gabe. I'm focused full time on Hedwig.
- [Docs | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): Add the local Hedwig MCP checker to your agent, set your payment rules and run a sample. Your wallet or application controls signing.
- [Add an eval gate | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): Add Hedwig to your agent through local MCP. Install the free policy checker and run a sample without sending funds.

## Setup

These guides install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): local setup and owner approval.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): payment checks through MCP.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
